title: Rate Committee Sheet — Farm Real Estate Loans: Fixed Periods, Initial Rates, Margins, Caps, Floors and Rate Locks
content:
The current rate sheet for Farm Real Estate Loans sets eight rate terms for each FarmLand product. Their meanings are fixed as follows.

- **Fixed period (months)** — months the closing (or conversion) rate stays fixed before the first adjustment; 0 means variable throughout; for the fully fixed products it equals the amortization.
- **Initial rate (annual %)** — the contract rate before discounts for a loan closed or converted under the current rate sheet; 0 means the rate is set from the base rate instead.
- **Variable-rate spread (percentage points)** — the points over the Association Variable Base Rate for the variable-rate product.
- **Reset margin (percentage points)** — the points over the Association Variable Base Rate used at each scheduled adjustment of an adjustable product.
- **Periodic adjustment cap (percentage points)** — the most the rate may rise or fall at one scheduled adjustment; 0 means no scheduled adjustment.
- **Lifetime cap over the initial rate (percentage points)** — the most the rate may ever exceed the loan's initial rate; 0 means no lifetime cap (variable) or no adjustment (fixed).
- **Rate floor (annual %)** — the lowest contract rate after discounts and adjustments.
- **Rate lock (calendar days)** — the calendar days a quoted rate is held for an application from the lock date to closing.

## The sheet

| Product | Fixed period (months) | Initial rate (%) | Variable-rate spread | Reset margin | Periodic cap | Lifetime cap over initial | Rate floor (%) | Rate lock (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 0 | 0.0 | 0.25 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 5.0 | 0 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 36 | 6.85 | 0.0 | 0.10 | 2.0 | 5.0 | 5.25 | 45 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 60 | 6.95 | 0.0 | 0.20 | 2.0 | 5.0 | 5.25 | 45 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 120 | 7.15 | 0.0 | 0.35 | 2.0 | 5.0 | 5.25 | 60 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 180 | 7.25 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 5.5 | 60 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 300 | 7.45 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 5.5 | 60 |

## How the sheet reads

- **Variable-rate product.** A fixed period of 0 and an initial rate of 0 mark the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage: its rate is set from the Association Variable Base Rate plus its 0.25-point spread, with no periodic or lifetime cap, never below 5.0 percent. It carries no rate lock (0 days).
- **Adjustable products.** The 3-, 5- and 10-Year Adjustable Mortgages hold their initial rate for 36, 60 and 120 months, then reset at the Association Variable Base Rate plus their margin, moving no more than 2.0 points at one adjustment.
- **Fully fixed products.** The 15-Year and 25-Year Fixed Mortgages are fixed for 180 and 300 months — their whole amortization — so their caps are 0 (no adjustment).

**Lifetime ceilings (derived illustration).** Because the lifetime cap is measured over the loan's own initial rate, a 3-Year Adjustable loan whose initial rate was 6.85 percent can never exceed 11.85 percent (6.85 plus 5.0); a 5-Year Adjustable loan whose initial rate was 6.95 percent can never exceed 11.95 percent; and a 10-Year Adjustable loan whose initial rate was 7.15 percent can never exceed 12.15 percent. A loan whose initial rate differs has its ceiling 5.0 points above its own initial rate.
